Show HN: Win Stats – open-source system monitoring in the Windows taskbar
show_hn.story_text: I've built a small Windows utility called Win Stats that shows live system stats directly in the taskbar. I used to open Task Manager multiple times just to check RAM usage, CPU/GPU usage, temperatures and other system stats. I wanted something that could show all of this at a glance. It's Similar to the popular macOS app called Stats It supports CPU, RAM, GPU, disk speeds, network usage, CPU/GPU temperatures and customizable layouts. It's completely free and open source, with no paywalls or monetization :) GitHub: https://github.com/VC067/win-stats Website: https://vc067.gi

show_hn.title: Show HN: Spindle – a full-featured, type-safe web framework for OCaml 5
show_hn.story_text: Spindle is a multicore-by-design, eio-native web framework for modern OCaml. Its central idea is to provide an expressive, type-driven API and derive the rest: codecs, request validation, OpenAPI spec and frontend schemas (Zod and Melange). This keeps contracts in sync between server and client without maintaining separate definitions. The framework includes an RFC-strict HTTP server, composable dependencies, WebSockets, SSE and high-level primitives for building MCP servers. It also provides production-ready essentials like distributed tracing, OT-compatible metrics, logging and other features you would expect.
